scope: Read-only direction study of accepted Mini v18 and Poke v19 plus original native source clips. Recipe proposals are data for the shared catalogue/API; no skill, scene, media or engine was changed.

interpretation.user_circle_to_square: Confirmed in Poke. A circular Poke identity becomes a rounded app square, not a sharp-cornered square. The palm silhouette and blue material also change, and the verification badge enters separately.
interpretation.not_just_radius: The accepted renderer uses 17 one-native-frame pose groups with measured radius/center/scale, independent texture clips and native palm paths. The reusable API may expose radius/path/material tracks, but an exact preset should replay the measured numeric states rather than substitute a generic crossfade.
interpretation.mini_motion: The Mini App effect combines an anchored result-card arrival, a local pressed state, a separately moving app sheet and receding Messages page, then an optional world-space food/message flourish while the phone pulls back.

frame_convention: Zero-based native frames. End gates are exclusive; listed motif ranges are inclusive. All keyframe t values in canonical JSON are seconds. Evaluate ancestor life, opacity, camera and clips before calling a layer visible.

viewing_evidence.method: Exact source and accepted encoded GSAP frames decoded read-only, assembled into in-memory paired thumbnail strips and visually inspected. No new screenshot/media files written.

recipes.title: Turn a familiar identity into an actionable app
recipes.visual_intent: Keep the same identity at the same visual center while its shape and symbol become more app-like; the viewer reads continuity before noticing the new capability.
choose_when: A friendly contact/agent is being introduced as a tool that can act.
A logo or mascot has both circular/social and rounded-square/app forms with a shared visual signature.
avoid_when: The two states have unrelated identities or the change would imply a different sender.
The icon is too small for a palm/symbol change to read, or the surrounding screen is changing rapidly enough to hide the handoff.
required_components: Native rounded surface with independent radius/center/scale tracks
Two bounded identity materials clipped by a stable parent aperture
Editable symbol path poses or a compatible path morph
camera_clip_states: Held measured shape/material/palm poses 64–80; surface and parent clips share the same radius.
Material identity changes near72; badge starts 72 with its own entrance.
Static square asset starts 81 and retains the shared identity camera.

sound_hooks.note: A restrained non-UI accent may support the identity change. No tap/keyboard event is visible or claimed; this is absent from the observed UI-cue manifest.

validation: Compare circle endpoint63, texture/badge handoff72 and square handoff81 in source and output.
Hold icon center and caption relationship through the change; do not allow the crop to slide when radius changes.
Check symbol silhouette independently from material corners.

recipes.title: Launch a rich result from the conversation rhythm
recipes.visual_intent: A useful object arrives from the chat flow, grows quickly enough to feel responsive, then holds so the viewer can read and choose it.
choose_when: An assistant has just promised or returned a concrete result: restaurant, document, product or booking.
The card is the next meaningful interaction and deserves one focused arrival.
avoid_when: Every ordinary text answer would receive the same large bounce.
A very small/low-opacity first state would be mistaken for a broken or delayed load in the intended presentation.
required_components: RichCard native shell/footer + separately replaceable bounded artwork
hierarchy_back_to_front: MessagesCamera > CardOuterAffine > CardInnerAffine > CardShell + Artwork + Footer + PressOverlay
camera_clip_states: Card is first tiny and partly censored at 546; opacity.1795.
Small world-scale overshoot near 555, then hold with conversation-camera settling through566.
Card-only dark press605–608, release609–614; sheet presentation begins618.

sound_hooks.note: Quiet onset; first state is tiny and low-confidence optical fit.
Grounded in independent pressed material; do not darken/sound the whole page.

validation: Validate composed artwork corners at548/551/555 rather than individual SVD angles.
Keep native title/footer geometry and artwork under the same card transform.
Compare press and release probes against unchanged blank page brightness.

recipes.title: Open an app inside chat, then let its result escape the frame
recipes.visual_intent: First make the app feel seated inside the phone through depth and occlusion. After the task is understood, optionally pull back and let a few meaningful result objects become a wider motion-graphics composition.
choose_when: A rich card leads to actual choices or a task-specific app panel.
A launch/demo film needs one expansion from credible UI into a playful broader product metaphor.
avoid_when: The user only needs a simple answer and the sheet would add needless steps.
Detached objects would obscure the controls while the viewer is still reading or choosing.
A world-space flourish would imply new messages or physical user input that did not happen.
required_components: Messages/backplane plane with its own scale/projection/dim
Screen aperture plus explicit paper/photo occlusion masks
Optional world-space result actor system with independent lifetimes
camera_clip_states: Presentation 618–630: sheet enters while underlying Messages recedes/dims.
Interaction 630–729: physical phone, row planes and projected backplane continue independently; cropped sheet top does not mean the entire backplane disappears.
Return 730–734: foreground sheet closes with photo/body union ownership preserved; world actors start outside the screen aperture.
Retreat 735–799: independent phone/UI cameras settle while actor alpha/affine/clip lifetimes remain separate.

sound_hooks.note: Observed numeral changes; do not invent earlier plus-button taps.
One quiet return cue can cover the start of world release; no separate send sound for every flying Order! duplicate.

validation: At 630/678/700/729 inspect all four: paper edge, exposed backplane ink, thumbnail highlights and bezel occlusion.
At 730–734 verify no food/Order duplicate is baked into backplane ink.
At 769 verify world actors do not scale with the phone camera; edge-cropped actors are intentional.
Honor opacity 0 slot gates and native lifetimes; avoid interpolating an invisible actor between unrelated matched poses.

recipes.title: Resolve a choice into a readable chat result
recipes.visual_intent: Make selection feel committed, then move the outcome into the conversation so the agent can continue naturally.
choose_when: One option has been chosen and the completed choice should become visible conversation history.
A UI demonstration needs to connect an in-message app decision with the agent’s follow-up.
avoid_when: The selection is merely hovered, tentative or still part of an unfinished multiselect.
A smooth shape morph would conceal the text or falsely imply the existing list physically became the bubble.
required_components: OptionList with independent selected-row press state
camera_clip_states: Press starts 339, reaches minimum ink opacity at 347 and releases 348–360.
Options are alive through 360 only; selected result and task caption begin 361.
Result camera independently settles 361–375; next incoming message begins 375.

sound_hooks.note: One press cue, not a sound for each opacity sample.

validation: Compare347 for visible pressure and361 for exact root lifecycle handoff.
Do not retain the option list under the result after 361.
Keep task caption, result card and phone hardware independent during pullback.

implementation_rules: Keep physical phone, screen/UI camera, foreground app panel, photo/art overhang, and world-space actors separate. A phone-scale tween alone cannot reproduce their observed parallax.
A large positive outer rotation and negative inner rotation can be an SVD affine factorization. Use the composed world matrix to direct movement; do not interpret those raw angles as a visible spin.
Place texture clipping on a parent in the intended local coordinate system. The old image-local clip offset caused material errors; clipping must not drift with an image crop inset.
A white sheet silhouette does not own independently moving thumbnail overhangs. Preserve explicit over/under order and masks for paper, projected backplane ink, photos and hardware.
Exact held/per-frame presets and reusable procedural motion are different products. Label procedural easing as a new motion interpretation; do not promise source identity from one generic spring.
Static original logo/photo/emoji/rich-card interiors are declared bounded bitmap assets. Native paths/geometry/cameras are editable, but these presets do not make bitmap internal text live-editable.

UI sound hooks follow the accepted preview frame. Actual press/selection/send evidence takes priority; do not assign keyboard sounds to title reveals, camera moves, palm morphs or decorative Order! copies.
research_steps: Read current canonical 03 v18 / 04 v19 manifests and current delivery-state evidence pins; identify nodes by stable IDs instead of obsolete release labels.
Find Poke 17-pose circle/square sequence; inspect original and accepted frames 63/64/70/72/76/81. Correct the interpretation to rounded app square plus independent palm/material/badge changes.
Read logo-morph and material-blend ledgers. Notice original V10 suggested a 72–79 crossfade, but accepted V13 fits a near-complete material switch at 72; use accepted states.
Inspect original/accepted Mini card arrival, modal depth and food-world release frames; separate actual world movement from paired affine rotation representation.
Read foreground/backplane/photo ownership fixes and current clip hierarchy. Preserve the learned occlusion correction rather than copying a flattened screen.
Inspect original/accepted Poke Indian choice press→selected-message cut. Record its lifecycle handoff at 361 instead of describing a continuous list-to-bubble shape morph.
Map measured UI cue hooks to frozen03/04 cue manifests; keep optional motion-design accents distinct from observed UI input.

checks: Canonical IDs and declared properties resolved from accepted snapshots
Original and accepted six-frame strips visually inspected read-only
validation.limitation: A direction/component catalogue, not a fresh renderer or a claim of pixel-perfect output. Numerical sample states include explicit lifetime_active/effective_opacity to prevent applying an out-of-life fallback pose.
validation.exact_keyframe_extraction: Included selected canonical property keyframes and their boundary context for every declared motion layer; no path/font/media duplication.
